Overview
Goals: In this assignment, you will implement two offline reinforcement learning algo-
rithms: Advantage-Weighted Actor-Critic (AWAC) and Implicit Q-Learning (IQL). You
will compare their performance across offline datasets on tasks of different difficulty lev-
els in Antmaze which is a domain from D4RL. You will also study the stitching behavior
of offline RL using IQL in the PointMass environment.
